Board of Trustees Minutes Date: August 11, 2025 4 Record of Vote: Board Member Aye Nay Abstained Absent Mayor Peeler X Trustee Healey X Trustee Dumar X Trustee Sprague X Trustee Klim X Resolution Adopted: Yes No RESOLUTION #45-2025 DESIGNATION OF ACTING AUTHORITY FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS IN THE ABSENCE OF THE STREET & WATER COMMISSIONER WHEREAS, the Village of Fonda relies upon the efficient operation of the Department of Public Works (DPW) to maintain essential public services; and WHEREAS, the Street and Water Commissioner, Christopher Weaver, customarily reviews, signs and distributes payroll for DPW laborers reviews and certifies payroll, and oversees DPW projects; and WHEREAS, it is necessary to ensure that payroll, project oversight, and departmental operations continue without interruption during any period when the Street and Water Commissioner is absent or otherwise unable to perform these duties; NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that the Board of Trustees of the Village of Fonda hereby authorizes Daniel Gray, Department of Public Works, to: • Review, sign, and distribute payroll to the DPW laborers Review and certify payroll in the absence of Christopher Weaver, Street and Water Commissioner; • Lead and oversee DPW projects in coordination with the Mayor during such periods of absence; • Report directly to the Mayor on any operational issues, needs, or concerns of the department during such periods. BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED, that this authorization shall be continuous and shall apply to any period when the Street and Water Commissioner is absent and unable to complete these duties, unless modified or rescinded by subsequent resolution of the Board of Trustees. Motion by: Mayor Peeler Discussion: Clerk Treasurer Kearns mentioned that Street and Water Commissioner Weaver certifies the entire payroll not just the DPW payroll. Mayor Peeler – amend to state “review and certify”. Seconded by: Trustee Healey, with amendment Record of Vote: Board Member Aye Nay Abstained Absent Mayor Peeler X Trustee Healey X Trustee Dumar X Trustee Sprague X Trustee Klim X Resolution Adopted: Yes No RESOLUTION #46-2025 COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS FOR OUTSIDE RENTERS OF MONTGOMERY COUNTY FAIRGROUNDS FACILITIES WHEREAS, the Village of Fonda has adopted Chapter 65 of the Village Code – Mass Public Gatherings – to ensure public safety, health, and welfare during events of 250 or more attendees within the Village limits; and WHEREAS, the Montgomery County Agricultural Society, a non-profit entity, owns and operates the fairgrounds within the Village, and while exempt from certain fees under New York State Agriculture & Markets Law for its own exhibitions and entertainments, it leases the facilities to outside renters and promoters for other public events; and

Board of Trustees Minutes Date: August 11, 2025 5 WHEREAS, the Village Board has determined that such outside renters and promoters are subject to the provisions of Chapter 65 of the Village Code, including but not limited to permit application, submission of safety and operational plans, proof of insurance, and payment of applicable fees; and WHEREAS, it is the intent of the Village Board to formalize and uniformly apply these requirements to all outside renters of the fairgrounds facilities beginning with the 2026 season; NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that effective January 1, 2026, all outside renters, lessees, or promoters utilizing the Montgomery County Fairgrounds for public events meeting the attendance threshold set forth in Chapter 65 of the Village Code shall: 1. Apply for and obtain a permit from the Village Board in accordance with Chapter 65 prior to the event or season of events; 2. Submit all required documentation, including safety, sanitation, and traffic plans; proof of liability insurance naming the Village of Fonda and the Montgomery County Agricultural Society as additional insureds; and written acknowledgment from the Agricultural Society authorizing the event; 3. Pay the applicable permit fee unless expressly exempt under New York State law; and 4. Comply with all conditions of the permit as imposed by the Village Board, including coordination with the Agricultural Society and any applicable state or county agency requirements. 5. Compliance With Village Laws – All outside renters, lessees, or promoters utilizing the Montgomery County Fairgrounds for public events must comply with all applicable laws, regulations, and permit requirements of the Village of Fonda, whether or not specifically referenced in the permit application or this resolution. Issuance of a Mass Public Gathering Permit by the Village does not exempt the applicant from obtaining or complying with any other required permits, licenses, or approvals. 6. Sales Tax Compliance – Any event involving the sale of taxable goods or services must be conducted in compliance with New York State Tax Law. The applicant shall provide the Village of Fonda with proof of a valid New York State sales tax registration (Certificate of Authority) for themselves and, where applicable, ensure that all vendors participating in the event are properly registered. The applicant shall maintain records of such compliance and make them available to the Village upon request. 7. Rain Date Policy – A one-time waiver shall be granted at no additional cost for a single rain date scheduled to immediately follow the originally permitted event date. Any further postponements or changes beyond the one - time waiver shall require a new permit application and applicable fees. BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED, that the Village Clerk shall notify the Montgomery County Agricultural Society of this resolution and provide application materials to any known outside renter or promoter planning events for the 2026 season. Board of Trustees Minutes Date: August 11, 2025 6 WHEREAS, this work is necessary for the continued progress and completion of the Water System Improvements Project and will be formally documented as a change order with all required paperwork to follow; and WHEREAS, the Board of Trustees desires to authorize the Mayor to execute any and all necessary documents to proceed with this work; NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that the Village Board of Trustees hereby approves PCO #10 – Additional SCADA Work in the amount of $43,159.00, authorizes the Mayor to sign all related documents, and directs that the work proceed as outlined in the proposal from O’Connell Electric Company, Inc.
